newsitem.title: USA: ITT Corp buys Atlantic City Mall.
newsitem.headline: ITT Corp buys Atlantic City Mall.

text.p: ITT Corp said Tuesday it bought One Ocean Mall in Atlantic City, N.J. from The Equitable Life Assurance Society of the U.S. Terms of the purchase were not disclosed.

The 400,000 square foot mall is located in front of the entrance to ITT's Caesars Atlantic City Hotel and Casino. The property is designed to resemble an ocean liner and consists of three shopping levels with 129 retail outlets, a food court and four restaurants. It has been open since 1983.
ITT spokesman Jim Gallagher said the mall will compliment a recently announced $280 million expansion of Caesars Atlantic City.
ITT Corporation, with 1995 pro forma sales of approximately $6.5 billion is comprised of ITT Sheraton, Caesars World, a 50 percent stake in Madison Square Garden and other investments.
